description: This is a Java source file defining a REST controller for device management in a Spring Boot application. It provides API endpoints for CRUD operations, listing, and statistics related to devices, with multi-tenant support via user ID headers.

classes.name: DeviceController
classes.description: REST controller handling device management APIs with endpoints for CRUD operations, listing, search, and statistics.

methods.name: getAllDevices
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of devices, with optional search filtering.

methods.name: getDeviceById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific device by ID.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to register a new device.

methods.name: updateDevice
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing device by ID.

methods.name: deleteDevice
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a device by ID.

methods.name: getDeviceStatistics
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve device count statistics grouped by protocol.
